owner: Samira Hanif and the Bellissima team
summary: A salon trading since 1990 appears to lose bookings because clients can only ring or email, hours are not listed and the homepage has a typo.

findings.problem: The page appears to offer no online booking, only a phone number, an email address and a Facebook link, with please ring for an appointment repeated.
findings.cost: Many clients decide in the evening or on their phone, and a salon they cannot book online loses them to one that they can.
findings.fix: Online booking with a simple calendar.

findings.problem: No opening hours appear on the homepage, only working flexible hours.
findings.cost: A new client cannot tell when you are open, and an unclear answer means they try another salon.
findings.fix: Clear hours and a Book Now button on every page.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to say flexible hours to suite our clients best, a typo, and We are OPEN and welcome all our old and new clients, which reads like old notice wording.
findings.cost: A typo on the first screen lowers trust, and old notice wording makes the page look unattended.

findings.problem: The price list appears to be only a download link, and the special offers section says offers come from time to time.
findings.cost: A client who wants a price must download a file, and a vague offers section gives no reason to book today.
findings.fix: A price page and a live offers block.
